  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Finance Manager, Asset Management",
  "description": "Rand Merchant Bank (RMB), a division of FirstRand Bank Limited, is a leading African corporate and investment bank and part of one of the largest financial services groups in Africa. We offer our clients innovative, value-added advisory, funding, trading, corporate banking and principal investing solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Finance Manager, Asset Management

Job Requisition ID: R53644
Job Location: Lagos

Job Description


	The Finance Manager will serve primarily as the financial and management reporting manager for the Asset Management business and assist in carrying out end-to-end financial (regulatory, management, statutory) reporting, business partnering, budgeting and forecasting, remittance of taxes (VAT, CIT, WHT and others), and other duties as part of their broader financial responsibilities.


Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:


	Preparation of regulatory returns, including monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual returns to SEC for the business and all managed funds and portfolios.
	Coordinate internal and external audit engagements and preparation of audited financial statements for the business and managed funds.
	Effective performance management of the business; daily monitoring and tracking of managed funds and portfolios.
	Preparation of management and performance reports, including monthly Exco reports, and quarterly board reports and any ad hoc reports requested by the Asset Management business.
	Preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts; oversee budgetary monitoring and control functions.
	Ensure completeness and accuracy of the General ledger; preparation of month-end journals; responsible for periodic general ledger substantiation and reconciliation.
	Coordinate all internal, regulatory, and statutory tax audits; liaise with external auditors, SEC, and other relevant regulators.
	Coordination and preparation of monthly WHT, VAT and other taxes returns and ensuring timely remittance of same.
	Ensure appropriate financial controls in all accounting processes and new product development.
	Liaise with various internal and external service providers and manage all service level agreements.
	Undertake any additional duties as directed by CFO.


Qualifications and Experience


	The successful candidate should have a relevant Degree qualification and must be a qualified Chartered Accountant with at least ten (10) years of working experience in the capital markets, preferably with a SEC-licensed Fund/Portfolio Manager.
	Minimum of 10 years of accounting experience in an asset management company.
	ACCA or ICAN, university degree in Accounting/Business/Finance.
	Full-cycle financial reporting knowledge
	Ability to analyze financial data, prepare reports, and process documentation.
	Experience using Infoware system application would be an added advantage
	Sound analytical thinking, planning, prioritization, and execution skills.
	Good Microsoft Office skills
	Attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills and organization skills.


Technical skills:


	Good appreciation and understanding of preparation of financial statements and finance operations.
	A good understanding of regulatory reporting requirements.
	Good understanding of IFRS and its applications.
	Proficient in the use of computer accounting systems and Microsoft Office tools and spreadsheets.
	A good understanding of the asset management industry.


General:


	Good judgment and decision-making skills
	High levels of ethics, numeracy and literacy are essential
	Strong interpersonal and analytical skills
	Listening, analysis and debating skills.


Human Relations Profile:


	Strong character &amp; integrity paramount
	High degree of self-confidence; pleasant personality; well presented
	Well organized / good time management skills / disciplined/ detail orientated
	Self-starter able to work with minimal supervision
	Team oriented
	Flexible when necessary
	Ability to work under pressure
	A strong communicator who is deadline and solutions-driven.
	Able to work as part of a highly innovative and competitive team, meeting demanding deadlines.
	A high degree of professionalism
	Attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.

Finance Manager, Asset Management Job at Rand Merchant Bank (RMB)




        
    

        
        Rand Merchant Bank (RMB), a division of FirstRand Bank Limited, is a leading African corporate and investment bank and part of one of the largest financial services groups in Africa. We offer our clients innovative, value-added advisory, funding, trading, corporate banking and principal investing solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Finance Manager, Asset Management

Job Requisition ID: R53644
Job Location: Lagos

Job Description
     

            
    




	The Finance Manager will serve primarily as the financial and management reporting manager for the Asset Management business and assist in carrying out end-to-end financial (regulatory, management, statutory) reporting, business partnering, budgeting and forecasting, remittance of taxes (VAT, CIT, WHT and others), and other duties as part of their broader financial responsibilities.


Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:


	Preparation of regulatory returns, including monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual returns to SEC for the business and all managed funds and portfolios.
	Coordinate internal and external audit engagements and preparation of audited financial statements for the business and managed funds.
	Effective performance management of the business; daily monitoring and tracking of managed funds and portfolios.
	Preparation of management and performance reports, including monthly Exco reports, and quarterly board reports and any ad hoc reports requested by the Asset Management business.
	Preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts; oversee budgetary monitoring and control functions.
	Ensure completeness and accuracy of the General ledger; preparation of month-end journals; responsible for periodic general ledger substantiation and reconciliation.
	Coordinate all internal, regulatory, and statutory tax audits; liaise with external auditors, SEC, and other relevant regulators.
	Coordination and preparation of monthly WHT, VAT and other taxes returns and ensuring timely remittance of same.
	Ensure appropriate financial controls in all accounting processes and new product development.
	Liaise with various internal and external service providers and manage all service level agreements.
	Undertake any additional duties as directed by CFO.


Qualifications and Experience


	The successful candidate should have a relevant Degree qualification and must be a qualified Chartered Accountant with at least ten (10) years of working experience in the capital markets, preferably with a SEC-licensed Fund/Portfolio Manager.
	Minimum of 10 years of accounting experience in an asset management company.
	ACCA or ICAN, university degree in Accounting/Business/Finance.
	Full-cycle financial reporting knowledge
	Ability to analyze financial data, prepare reports, and process documentation.
	Experience using Infoware system application would be an added advantage
	Sound analytical thinking, planning, prioritization, and execution skills.
	Good Microsoft Office skills
	Attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills and organization skills.


Technical skills:


	Good appreciation and understanding of preparation of financial statements and finance operations.
	A good understanding of regulatory reporting requirements.
	Good understanding of IFRS and its applications.
	Proficient in the use of computer accounting systems and Microsoft Office tools and spreadsheets.
	A good understanding of the asset management industry.


General:


	Good judgment and decision-making skills
	High levels of ethics, numeracy and literacy are essential
	Strong interpersonal and analytical skills
	Listening, analysis and debating skills.


Human Relations Profile:


	Strong character & integrity paramount
	High degree of self-confidence; pleasant personality; well presented
	Well organized / good time management skills / disciplined/ detail orientated
	Self-starter able to work with minimal supervision
	Team oriented
	Flexible when necessary
	Ability to work under pressure
	A strong communicator who is deadline and solutions-driven.
	Able to work as part of a highly innovative and competitive team, meeting demanding deadlines.
	A high degree of professionalism
	Attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
